title: Co-area formula on one C¹ chart piece for a function that is C¹ along the chart
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let V ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} be open and ψ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P be C¹ on V and injective on V, with Dψ(y) injective for every y ∈ V. Let C ⊆ V be compact and Y ⊆ C Borel. Let F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ be C¹ and f : ℝ^P → ℝ satisfy f(ψ(y)) = F(y) for y ∈ Y. Let G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Borel such that for every y ∈ Y: G(ψ(y)) ∈ Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) and ⟨G(ψ(y)), Dψ(y)e⟩ = DF(y)e for all e ∈ ℝ^{n+1}. (G is the tangential gradient of f on ψ(Y).) For t ∈ ℝ put S_t := ψ(Y) ∩ {x : G(x) ≠ 0} ∩ f⁻¹(t). Then for every Borel φ : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]:
 - the function t ↦ ∫_{S_t} φ dHⁿ is a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure on ℝ, and
 - ∫_ℝ ∫_{S_t} φ dHⁿ dt = ∫_{ψ(Y)} |G| φ dH^{n+1}.
Here Hᵏ = μHE[k] and all integrals are lower integrals in [0, ∞].
